SELECT c.id AS conversationId, c.name AS conversationName, MAX(ed.round_num) AS latestRoundNum, count(ed) as diagnosisCount MAX(ed.updated_time) AS diagnosisUpdatedTime, c.created_time AS conversationCreatedTime FROM conversation c INNER JOIN emotion_diagnosis ed ON c.id = ed.conversation_id AND ed.deleted = 0 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{conversationName}, '%')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.created_time ORDER BY diagnosisUpdatedTime DESC
